rubrics.criterion: The opening journey uses a sticky full-viewport illustrated scene whose artwork and story card change as each narrative step crosses the viewport.
The masthead reproduces the coral and deep-red nested title card, Devanagari overline, oversized title, logo, and editorial byline.
The name comparison lab accepts two editable names and immediately recomputes a visible bigram similarity percentage and matching letter pairs.
The article presents the original hand-drawn election artwork, warm paper palette, compact editorial typography, bold section headings, and scroll reveal motion responsively.
The election-impact ending includes a highlighted 28-election statistic and a horizontally usable responsive table of close results, margins, namesakes, and probabilities.
